title: Tendencies & Bad Results: 嫌いがある, 羽目になる, 始末だ, きりがない, 思いをする, ときている, ところがある
description: Tends to (badly), end up stuck with, end up (as the last straw), there's no end, go through (a feeling), and on top of that, and has a side.

points.title: 〜きらいがある: tends to (badly)
points.summary: Dictionary form / Nの + きらいがある = has an unfortunate tendency.
points.body: - 彼は物事を大げさに言う**きらいがある**.
examples: {最近|さいきん}の{若者|わかもの}は{読書|どくしょ}を{軽視|けいし}するきらいがある。
Young people these days tend to neglect reading.

points.title: 〜羽目になる: end up (stuck with)
points.summary: Dictionary form + 羽目になる = end up in an unwanted situation.
points.body: - 財布を忘れて、家まで歩いて帰る**羽目になった**.
examples: {結局|けっきょく}{一人|ひとり}で{全部|ぜんぶ}やる{羽目|はめ}になった。
In the end I got stuck doing it all myself.

points.title: 〜始末だ: end up (the last straw)
points.summary: Dictionary form + 始末だ = after all that, it even came to A (exasperated).
points.body: - 遅刻ばかりして、ついには会社を首になる**始末だ**.
examples: {弟|おとうと}は{最後|さいご}には{泣|な}き{出|だ}す{始末|しまつ}だった。
In the end my brother even started crying.

points.title: 〜きりがない: there's no end
points.summary: ば / たら / と + きりがない = it would go on forever.
points.body: - 文句を言い出したら**きりがない**.
examples: {上|うえ}を{見|み}ればきりがない。
If you compare yourself with those above, there's no end to it.

points.title: 〜思いをする: go through (a feeling)
points.summary: Adjective + 思いをする = experience that feeling. させる = make someone go through it.
points.body: - 外国で言葉が通じず、悔しい**思いをした**.
examples: {子供|こども}にはこんな{辛|つら}い{思|おも}いをさせたくない。
I don't want my children to go through such hardship.

points.title: 〜ときている: and on top of that
points.summary: Plain form + ときている = it has this (striking) quality, which explains what follows.
points.body: - この店は安くておいしい**ときている**から、いつも混んでいる.
examples: {彼|かれ}は{頭|あたま}がいい{上|うえ}に、{性格|せいかく}もいいときている。
He's smart, and on top of that he's got a great personality.

points.title: 〜ところがある: has a side
points.summary: Plain form + ところがある = has that aspect / streak.
points.body: - 彼は優しいが、頑固な**ところがある**.
examples: {彼女|かのじょ}には{子供|こども}っぽいところがある。

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{物事|ものごと}を{大|おお}げさに{言|い}う（　）。
questions.translation: He has a tendency to exaggerate.

questions.prompt: What does 「{最近|さいきん}の{若者|わかもの}は{読書|どくしょ}を{軽視|けいし}するきらいがある。」 mean?
options: Young people these days tend to neglect reading.
Young people are disliked for not reading.

questions.prompt: {財布|さいふ}を{忘|わす}れて、{家|いえ}まで{歩|ある}いて{帰|かえ}る（　）。
questions.explanation: End up stuck with: **羽目になる**.
questions.translation: I forgot my wallet and ended up having to walk home.

questions.prompt: What does 「{結局|けっきょく}{一人|ひとり}で{全部|ぜんぶ}やる{羽目|はめ}になった。」 mean?
options: I finally learned to do it all.
In the end I chose to do it all myself.
In the end I got stuck doing it all myself.
questions.explanation: 羽目になる = **end up stuck with**.
notes: 羽目 = an unwanted situation, not a choice.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{遅刻|ちこく}ばかりして、ついには{会社|かいしゃ}を{首|くび}になる（　）。
questions.translation: He was always late, and in the end he even got fired.

questions.prompt: What does 「{弟|おとうと}は{最後|さいご}には{泣|な}き{出|だ}す{始末|しまつ}だった。」 mean?
options: My brother stopped crying at the end.
My brother handled it without crying.
In the end my brother even started crying.
My brother cried at the start.
notes: 始末だ = it came to that.

questions.prompt: {文句|もんく}を{言|い}い{出|だ}したら（　）。
questions.translation: Once you start complaining, there's no end to it.

questions.prompt: What does 「{上|うえ}を{見|み}ればきりがない。」 mean?
options: If you compare yourself with those above, there's no end to it.
Look up and you'll see the fog.
notes: Close, but it's about endless comparison.

questions.prompt: {外国|がいこく}で{言葉|ことば}が{通|つう}じず、{悔|くや}しい（　）。
questions.translation: Abroad, nobody understood me — it was frustrating.

questions.prompt: What does 「{子供|こども}にはこんな{辛|つら}い{思|おも}いをさせたくない。」 mean?
options: I don't want my children to think about hard things.
My children don't want to go through hardship.
I don't want my children to go through such hardship.
I want my children to remember.
questions.explanation: 思いをさせる = **put someone through**.
notes: 思いをさせる = make someone experience.

questions.prompt: この{店|みせ}は{安|やす}くておいしい（　）、いつも{混|こ}んでいる。
questions.explanation: On top of that (so): **ときている**.
notes: ときたら = 'when it comes to (complaint)'.
questions.translation: This place is cheap and tasty to boot, so it's always packed.

questions.prompt: What does 「{彼|かれ}は{頭|あたま}がいい{上|うえ}に、{性格|せいかく}もいいときている。」 mean?
options: He's smart, but his personality is bad.
He's smart, and on top of that he's got a great personality.
questions.explanation: ときている = **and on top of that**.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{優|やさ}しいが、{頑固|がんこ}な（　）。
questions.explanation: Has a side: **ところがある**.
questions.translation: He's kind, but he has a stubborn streak.

questions.prompt: What does 「{彼女|かのじょ}には{子供|こども}っぽいところがある。」 mean?
options: She has a place for children.
questions.explanation: ところがある = **has a side**.
notes: ところ isn't a place here.
